reason: £300 for four refurbished wheels from a seller with no reviews isn't a deal I'd jump on when I can haggle on Marketplace and eBay. I'd rather see the wheels and have proof before I hand over money.
objection: New seller, no reviews, and I'd be paying cash or bank transfer up front for second-hand wheels I can't inspect. If they turn out bent or cracked I'm stuck, and the return only counts if they're unmarked, which is easy for them to dispute.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the exact set in person first, or real reviews, at around £220 to £240 with a pay-on-collection option.
